claim: Exact minimum unimodular-zero counts for reciprocal Littlewood polynomials at even degrees 8 through 24, with minimizer counts and witnesses.

correctness_evidence.method: fresh exact Chebyshev reduction over rationals, square-free factorization, and exact Sturm root counts on (-1,1) with multiplicity

literature.author: Benjamin Bedert
literature.title: On the zeros of reciprocal Littlewood polynomials
literature.coverage: Defines Z_L(N), records finite lower bounds, and proves asymptotic divergence; no exact 8-24 table found.

literature.author: Paulius Drungilas
literature.title: Unimodular roots of reciprocal Littlewood polynomials
literature.venue: Journal of the Korean Mathematical Society 45 (2008), 835-840
literature.coverage: Proves Z_L(N)>=4 for even N>=14, not the exact small-degree table.

value_reason: The contribution is an exhaustive census of only 8176 canonical polynomials and supplies no new structural theorem, lower-bound method, asymptotic information, or meaningful new regime; several entries merely meet a known lower bound.
repair: Reframing as a benchmark dataset with exact Sturm certificates improves reproducibility but does not restore sufficient scientific value.
